intro: Mumbai is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. The city of dreams, street food and sea-facing promenades — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Mumbai
paragraphs: Mumbai (Maharashtra) is known for its city, food and nightlife experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is November to February.
